events.title: Fall Family Festival
events.notes: Kick off the season with a festive gathering for the whole family. Expect trunk-or-treat-style fun, hands-on activities, and easy ways for Guard-connected families to meet, reconnect, and make fall memories together.

events.title: Cookies with Santa
events.notes: Settle in for a cheerful holiday gathering with cookies, time with Santa, and family-friendly activities. It is a relaxed chance for children and caregivers to celebrate, meet other Guard families, and make a holiday memory together.

events.title: MFE Cedar Falls
events.notes: Get ready for an active family outing at Get Air, a trampoline park with open-jump spaces and play designed for different ages. Between the movement and shared activities, families will have plenty of natural opportunities to laugh together and make new friends.

events.title: MFE Davenport
events.notes: The Fun Station makes it easy for families to play side by side, with trampolines, a kids' area, dodgeball, climbing, and other indoor attractions. Come ready to move, cheer one another on, and connect with Guard families from the Davenport area.

events.title: MFE Cedar Rapids
events.notes: Families can expect a lively indoor adventure setting with trampolines, climbing challenges, slides, games, and attractions for a range of ages. The shared fun creates an easygoing way to meet other Guard families and make memories together.

events.title: MFE Council Bluffs
events.notes: The Hub offers an energetic setting with trampolines, a ninja course, arcade games, and spaces for younger children. Families can play, take on friendly challenges, and get to know other Guard-connected families from the Council Bluffs area.

events.title: MFE Des Moines
events.notes: Emerge Academy brings families into a spacious gymnastics and Ninja Warrior setting with trampolines, foam pits, and obstacle-style challenges. Expect an active gathering where youth can try something new while families connect and encourage one another.

events.title: MFE Sioux City
events.notes: Drop Zone is built for active family fun, with trampolines, dodgeball, a ninja course, laser tag, and a play area for younger children. It is a welcoming setting to share a challenge, enjoy time together, and meet other Guard families in the Sioux City area.

events.title: Military Family Ball
events.notes: Dress up and celebrate military-connected youth with an evening of crafts, dancing, dinner, and time together. Families can enjoy a special night out, meet others who understand military life, and create a shared memory on the dance floor.

events.title: Summer Camp
events.notes: Campers spend the week on a scenic outdoor campus building independence, confidence, and friendships with peers who understand military life. Days may include team challenges and classic camp adventures such as swimming, paddling, climbing, horseback riding, and creative activities.
